# Theme art references

References guide **style only** (palette, depth, lighting, pixel density, layout). Nothing here is copied, traced or shipped. All RetroBake theme art is generated fresh (Pollinations) from `themes/styles.json` prompts, then upscaled.

## RetroArch XMB layout / theme showcases (how real themes read on screen)
| URL | What to take |
|---|---|
| https://forums.libretro.com/t/show-your-current-theme/8340 | How icon row + wallpaper + menu text read together; busy wallpapers hurt legibility, keep a calm area behind the menu list |
| https://forums.libretro.com/t/show-your-current-theme/8340/20 | Bright themed icon sets: one palette + one outline weight across every icon |
| https://forums.libretro.com/t/neoactive-retroactive-and-systematic-theme-support-and-feedback/9501/43 | Full custom icon theme structure (tabs, settings, every system + `-content`) |
| https://github.com/libretro/retroarch-assets/tree/master/xmb/monochrome/png | Exact icon file names (853 files, list in `docs/themes/xmb_icon_names.txt`) |
| https://awesome.ecosyste.ms/projects/github.com%2FSenkaWolf%2FSenkas-Retroarch-Setup | Per-system dynamic wallpapers named after playlists |
